question: ______, Secretary (L&E), completed his tenure as the Chair of the Governing Body of International Labour Organisation, after holding the position for the period October 2020 - June 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __** Apurva Chandra **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Apurva Chandra, Labour secretary of the union government completed his tenure as the **Chair of the Governing Body of International Labour Organisation **on **25 June 2021**
 
• He has handed over the responsibility of the chair to** Ambassador Anna Jardfelt**, **Permanent Representative of Sweden** to the united nations office in **Geneva.**
 
• A 1988 batch Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the Maharashtra cadre, Chandra replaced **Heeralal Samariya** as the labour secretary, following latter’s retirement.
 
• Before joining as the labour secretary, Chandra was serving as** Special Director General, Defence Acquisitio**n, in the Ministry of Defence.
